authority.rule: The nine readiness states remain the contract taxonomy; flavours are render-time variants only.

uxResponse.label: Bridge unavailable
uxResponse.detail: Reconnect through OmniPanel Gateway, then retry the readiness source.

uxResponse.label: awaiting profile.<field>
uxResponse.detail: A required profile field has not arrived in the readiness ledger.

uxResponse.label: S2 graph unreachable
uxResponse.detail: The S2 graph authority is not reachable; inspect diagnostics and Neo4j status.

uxResponse.label: S3 gateway down
uxResponse.detail: The S3 gateway subscription path is blocked.

uxResponse.label: atelier review pending
uxResponse.detail: Review authority has not cleared this surface yet.

uxResponse.label: authority payload pending
uxResponse.detail: A named owner must publish the payload before this surface can render fully.

uxResponse.label: protected_local - consent required
uxResponse.detail: Protected local material needs explicit opt-in before crossing the UI boundary.

uxResponse.label: degraded but readable
uxResponse.detail: The surface can render read-only chrome while an upstream authority catches up.

uxResponse.label: ready public current
uxResponse.detail: The public current payload is ready for normal rendering.

uxResponse.label: Awaiting first profile-tick...
uxResponse.detail: The bridge is up, but no profile tick has reached the runtime yet.

uxResponse.label: S3 gateway unreachable
uxResponse.detail: Render alias for the S3 subscription blocked contract state.

uxResponse.label: S5 atelier blocked
uxResponse.detail: Render alias for an S5 review block pending atelier action.

uxResponse.label: pending dataset
uxResponse.detail: A named dataset is still absent from the authority payload.

uxResponse.label: ready protected local
uxResponse.detail: Normal render with protected_local privacy-class marker and border tint.
